notes: Adds My Approvals — the reporting-chain inbox that mirrors the web page, covering leave, resignations and no-dues clearances. It shows for every role, because anyone can be someone's reporting manager in the org chart. Its bottom-tab badge counts only requests addressed to you and is kept separate from the HR-wide Approvals badge, so holding both roles no longer shows one merged number. The Attendance screen no longer prints the paragraph explaining the lateness and paid-leave rules; the figures above it are unchanged.
